units.source_text: 阿住忍不住睁开双眼眼。

en.t: Osumi could not help opening her eyes.

units.source_text: 孙子就躺在她身侧，脸上是天真无邪的睡容，睡的正香甜。

en.t: Her grandson lay right beside her, his face wearing an innocent sleeping expression as he slept soundly and sweetly.

units.source_text: 阿住看着孙子酣睡的面容，渐渐感觉自己真是一个苦命人。

en.t: As Osumi looked at her grandson's peacefully sleeping face, she gradually felt that she truly was a person with a bitter fate.

units.source_text: 与此同时，她觉得跟她之间有恶缘的儿子仁太郎和儿媳妇阿民也都是苦命人。

en.t: At the same time, she felt that her son Nitaro and her daughter-in-law Otami, both bound to her by an ill-fated tie, were also people with bitter fates.

units.source_text: 这种心境的变化，使得她完全忘了这九年间的恩恩怨怨。

en.t: This change in her state of mind made her completely forget all the debts, kindnesses, and resentments of the past nine years.

units.source_text: 不，甚至连让她感到慰藉的未来幸福也消失了。

en.t: No, even the future happiness that had given her comfort disappeared.

units.source_text: 他们母子、婆媳三个人都是苦命人，尤其是她命运最为悲惨。

en.t: The three of them, mother and son, mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, were all people with bitter fates, and hers was the most tragic of all.
Otami, how could you leave me?

units.source_text: ——阿住不由的喃喃呼唤刚去世的阿民，突然留下了热泪……

en.t: Osumi could not help murmuring the name of Otami, who had only just died, and suddenly hot tears fell from her eyes.
